name: shipmate
description: Engineering harness for solo developers: specify, plan, TDD run, independent AI review, walkthroughs, quizzes, diagnostic interrogation and UI/UX review.

interface.longDescription: Eight public actions—Specify, Plan, Run, Review, Walkthrough, Quiz, Ask and UI/UX—giving a solo developer independent review depth without a team.
defaultPrompt: Use shipmate:specify to prepare a reviewed engineering contract.
Use shipmate:plan to turn a requirement, task or rough idea into a reviewed implementation plan.
Use shipmate:run to deliver local requirements to a verified draft pull request or reviewed local commit.
Use shipmate:review to challenge a specification, plan or candidate.
Use shipmate:walkthrough to explain this merge request or local change in layers.
Use shipmate:quiz to check my understanding of this merge request or local change and show a report.
Use shipmate:ask to interrogate this target and give me the findings register with causal tree.
Use shipmate:uiux to build, polish or audit this web interface and give me the ranked report.
